entities.name: Water Filter
entities.description: Makes most water drinkable.

entities.name: Marine
entities.description: Marines are handy in a fight, but whenever they Panic it may cause problems for the rest of the crew.

Stats.Adjust: +10 combat, +10 body save, +20 fear save, +1 max wounds
Stats.Trauma response: Whenever you panic, every close friendly player must make a fear save.
Stats.Skills: Military training, Athletics. Bonus: 1 Expert Skill OR 2 Trained Skills.

entities.name: Teamster
entities.description: Teamsters keep the ships running. Rough, practical and hard to rattle.

Stats.Adjust: +5 to all stats, +10 to all saves
Stats.Trauma response: Once per session, you may take advantage on a panic check.
Stats.Skills: Industrial equipment, Zero-G. Bonus: 1 Trained Skill AND 1 Expert Skill.

entities.name: Android
entities.description: Androids are synthetic people. Capable and precise, and deeply unsettling to the crew.

Stats.Adjust: +20 intellect, -10 to 1 stat, +60 fear save, +1 max wounds
Stats.Trauma response: Fear saves made by close friendly players are at disadvantage.
Stats.Skills: Linguistics, Computers, Mathematics. Bonus: 1 Expert Skill OR 2 Trained Skills.

entities.name: Scientist
entities.description: Scientists know how the universe works, which makes it worse when it stops making sense.

Stats.Trauma response: Whenever you fail a sanity save, every close friendly player gains 1 stress.
Stats.Skills: 1 Master Skill with an Expert and a Trained Skill leading to it. Bonus: 1 Trained Skill.

entities.name: Corporate Security
entities.description: A guard paid to protect company property, not you.

entities.name: Pirate Raider
entities.description: Desperate, armed and looking for an easy score.

Stats.Special: Flees if half the crew go down.

entities.name: Feral Crewmember
entities.description: Someone who was crew, before the ship got into their head.

Stats.Special: Screams. Whoever hears it makes a fear save.

entities.name: Hostile Android
entities.description: Its directives changed. Calm voice, no hesitation.

Stats.Special: Feels no pain. Ignores the first wound effect.

entities.name: Hull Rat Swarm
entities.description: Hundreds of chittering vermin in the walls.

Stats.Special: Only area damage hurts it properly.

entities.name: Parasite Larva
entities.description: Small, fast and looking for a host.

Stats.Attack: Latch on, Body save or be implanted
Stats.Special: An implanted host births an adult in 1d10 hours.

entities.name: Hunter Drone
entities.description: A security drone with outdated friend-or-foe tags.

Stats.Special: Can fly. Fooled by a spoofed ID.

entities.name: Void Cultist
entities.description: Whispers about the gap between the stars.

Stats.Special: Close players make a sanity save when it speaks.

entities.name: Stalker
entities.description: A tall, silent alien that hunts through the vents.

Stats.Special: Vanishes into the dark after each attack.

entities.name: Abomination
entities.description: Flesh from many crew, fused together and still moving.

Stats.Special: Every player who sees it gains 1 stress.
